_doc: God layer stills (CONTRACT §15.6–15.8): the hand, creatures, disasters, weather, aurora, eclipse. Each scene is staged by its script (lookdev god commands + window.__GENESIS_FX__.advance(s) to move the FX clock, which otherwise only runs with sim time). Run: node _harness/shots.mjs _harness/specs/god.json

shots.name: god-hand-village
script: G.ui_.closeAll(); document.getElementById('boot')?.remove(); const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; F.fx.hand.force = true;
await G.frames(1); const a = G.agents(6).map((x) => x.id); const r = await G.cmd({ k: 'hand.grab', target: { kind: 'agent', id: a[0] } }); await G.step(1); await G.frames(2);
return { held: [F.fx.hand.heldKind, F.fx.hand.heldId], r };

shots.name: god-creatures
shots.script: window.__GENESIS_FX__.fx.hand.force = false; window.__GENESIS_FX__.advance(2); await G.frames(1); return window.__GENESIS_FX__.fx.creatures.count;

shots.name: god-meteor-1-before
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; F.fx.hand.force = false; const p = G.poi('farm');
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.disaster', kind: 'meteor', pos: p.pos, offset: [0, -2600], progress: 0.94, bearing: 90, radius: 120 });
await G.step(1); await G.camera({ mode: 'surface', lat: p.lat, lon: p.lon, alt: 60, yaw: 180, pitch: 14, hour: 17.3 });
F.advance(0.6); await G.frames(2); return [p.lat, p.lon];

shots.name: god-meteor-2-impact
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const p = G.poi('farm');
await G.cmd({ k: 'disaster.cancel', all: true }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.disaster', kind: 'meteor', pos: p.pos, offset: [0, -2600], progress: 1, bearing: 90, radius: 120 });
await G.step(1); await G.frames(1); F.advance(0.45); await G.frames(1);

shots.name: god-volcano-night
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const p = G.poi('peak');
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.disaster', kind: 'volcano', pos: p.pos, progress: 0.5, intensity: 1.3 });
await G.step(1); await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', poi: 'peak', dist: 3600, tilt: 74, hour: 23.5 });
F.advance(20); await G.frames(1); F.advance(4); await G.frames(1);

shots.name: god-tornado
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const p = G.poi('farm');
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'weather.clear' });
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.weather', kind: 'storm', pos: p.pos, offset: [0, 1600], radius: 1800, intensity: 0.8 });
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.disaster', kind: 'tornado', pos: p.pos, offset: [0, 1300], progress: 0.5, intensity: 1.2 });
await G.step(1); await G.camera({ mode: 'surface', lat: p.lat, lon: p.lon, alt: 30, yaw: 0, pitch: 13, hour: 16.5 });
F.advance(12); await G.frames(2);

shots.name: god-tsunami
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const p = G.poi('coast'); const h = p.heading * Math.PI / 180;
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'weather.clear' });
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.disaster', kind: 'tsunami', pos: p.pos, offset: [Math.sin(h) * 950, Math.cos(h) * 950], progress: 0.66, radius: 420, intensity: 1.5 });
await G.step(1); await G.camera({ mode: 'surface', poi: 'coast', alt: 28, pitch: 1, hour: 10.5, turn: -25 });
F.advance(6); await G.frames(2); return p.heading;

shots.name: god-blizzard-street
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const p = G.poi('town');
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'weather.clear' });
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.weather', kind: 'blizzard', pos: p.pos, radius: 2500, intensity: 1 });
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.field', field: 'snow', pos: p.pos, radius: 2500, value: 1 });
await G.step(1); await G.camera({ mode: 'surface', poi: 'town', alt: 2.2, pitch: 3, hour: 11 });
F.advance(8); await G.frames(2); return F.fx.m && F.fx.m.weather.local;

shots.name: god-eclipse
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const p = G.poi('valley');
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'weather.clear' });
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.disaster', kind: 'eclipse', pos: p.pos, progress: 0.5, params: { coverage: 0.995 } });
await G.step(1); await G.camera({ mode: 'surface', poi: 'valley', alt: 40, pitch: 16, sunElevation: 22, faceSun: true });
F.advance(4); await G.frames(2); return F.fx.screenState.eclipse;

shots.name: god-aurora-orbit
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const p = G.poi('peak');
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'weather.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.star', activity: 1 }); await G.cmd({ k: 'planet.set', magnetism: 1.2 });
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.disaster', kind: 'magnetic-storm', pos: p.pos, progress: 0.5 });
await G.step(1); await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', lat: 58, lon: 30, dist: 4200, tilt: 38, hour: 0.5 });
F.advance(30); await G.frames(2); return F.fx.m && F.fx.m.aurora.level;
